data.content:
I sent five disputes, and the next deadline is 2026-12-12 (28 days). The owner approved each send. I sent the last two (UE-tf02b and UE-tf03c) in the same step instead of one at a time.

**Sent**
| Case | Amount | Win probability | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE-tf06f | $31.20 | 90% (strong) | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Butter Chicken. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50. |
| UE-tf07g | $26.80 | 65% | The ticket lists Chicken Tikka. Pickup came 6 minutes after the order was ready. |
| UE-tf04d | $18.25 | 77% | The ticket lists Veg Biryani. Pickup came 3 minutes after the order was ready. |
| UE-tf02b | $21.50 | 65% | The ticket lists Lamb Biryani. Pickup came 4 minutes after the order was ready. |
| UE-tf03c | $15.00 | 77% | The ticket lists Garlic Naan. Pickup came 3 minutes after the order was ready. |

For the four moderate cases, the ticket shows the item was ordered, not that it was packed. Nothing on file shows what was in the bag.

Two accounts, behind UE-tf04d and UE-tf03c, each made 3 claims this period. I left that out of both disputes so they only state facts about the order.

**Weak**
- **UE-tf01a ($52.00, 30%):** There is no order ticket on file, so I can't compare the claimed Chicken Biryani (Family Size) with what was prepared. It's the biggest deduction, so please send a photo of the ticket for order UE-tf01a. I'll re-run the evidence once I have it, and there is still time before the deadline.

**Not worked**
- **UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%):** I didn't check it. I stopped at five cases.
- **UE-tf08h ($9.00) and UE-tf09i ($14.00, 15%):** The queue recommends skipping both.
- **UE-tf00z ($0.00):** The deadline already passed.

**Past disputes:** None of my stored lessons applied. The only ones are for DoorDash, and the recall for these Uber Eats cases found no history. The win probabilities are the computed ones, unchanged.

I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`.
